body.x: An open-plan office or a shared bedroom carries every nearby sound straight to the desk or the pillow. A steady wash of sound tuned to the room can soften what filters through.
Metablock Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in Artificial Intelligence at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for PEBL, an AI sound-masking system.

PEBL is a portable AI sound-masking system of four slim wireless speaker discs and a stacking charge dock, the description says. Placed around a desk or bed, the discs pick up ambient noise through built-in microphones, classify the acoustic situation on the device and generate masking sound in real time, combining engineered noise matched to the measured spectrum with natural textures such as rain and distant surf.

The four units synchronize over a wireless mesh and adjust output by direction, forming an even masking zone around the user rather than a single loud point. A companion app shows the live noise analysis and mix controls, and a microphone-free Speech-band preset covers conversation frequencies in privacy-sensitive rooms.
The description says all analysis runs on the device, no audio is stored or transmitted, and the stack charges as one unit and carries in one hand.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
